Partition centerlines, window bands (cyan flood fill) and door leaf/gap extents measured the same way. Corridor wall y-positions taken at world y=5.0/3.0 m to match the 3000/2000/3000 north-south zoning read from the drawing's own dimension chain, consistent with F1.
